criterion_1_unnumbered_anchors.notes: HTML doc without numbered headings. Every block must carry anchor.section_path non-empty and anchor.page = null.

criterion_2_stable_anchors.notes: build_sdm --check-determinism runs twice, sdm.json must be byte-identical.

criterion_3_L2_references.notes: The sample ledger references block_ids; every one must resolve to a real block in sdm.json.

duplicates_resolved_with_ordinal.notes: D5 says duplicate-numbered sections must each get a distinct section_path with ordinal suffix. Currently build_sdm uses outline section_path literally; this check documents the gap if it fails, not the criteria.
